title: React Router and Navigation
objectives: Master client-side routing, nested routes, and route protection.
theory_markdown: React Router enables client-side navigation without full page reloads. `BrowserRouter` wraps the app. `Routes` and `Route` define mappings. `Link` and `NavLink` navigate without reload. `useNavigate` programmatic navigation. `useParams` accesses URL parameters. Nested routes render child routes inside parent layouts.

code_walkthrough.explanation: `<Outlet />` renders child route content. `NavLink` adds active styling. `useParams` extracts URL parameters. `ProtectedRoute` redirects unauthenticated users. `path="*"` catches 404s.

ai_tool_spotlight.description:
Use **React Router DevTools** (free) to visualise route hierarchy.
